longChapters: The laptop is already open when this take starts.
Adapter demonstration, then the USB cable.
Interface demonstration and first connection attempt.
Spoken instruction: omit the previous attempt in the edit.
Converter demonstration; a retry is announced around 2:22.
A second take is requested at 2:47.
Female and male three-pin connectors are shown and joined.
Connect the first moving head, then power it.
Clear demonstration. The chain has only one fixture here.
Remove the terminator to extend the chain.
At 6:56 the narration suggests speeding up this work.
Yellow-label fixture joins the rig; cabling continues.
Repeated cable work. Treat as setup coverage, not a clean single insertion.
The LED bar lights up; later narration says connections are still being sorted.
Final wide view. Final terminator location remains unconfirmed.
shortChapters: Power strip and laptop charger before the laptop enters.
First moving head and cable preparation.
Clear adapter close-up and connection to the ENTTEC.
Cable preparation and a pause before connecting the fixture.
Wire and power the first device
Continued cable work around the fixture. Mains connection around 3:57–4:05.
Software and setup adjustments; no additional fixtures.
The single light moves and illuminates.
